name: shown by its creations
headline: Shown by its *creations*
visualData: The business card — your card, your links, your people · passed on with a scan
The Hyperdex — the people and domains you hold · your phone’s front page
Websites and games — published straight from tiles
Communities — meetups and gathering places, in hives
say: Here is the pattern, shown through what people make with it. The business card: your card, your links and your people, passed on with a scan, with nothing to sign up for. The Hyperdex: the people and the domains you hold, as your phone's front page, and it starts with you. Websites and games, published straight from tiles. And real communities, gathering in hives: meetups, study groups, and centres where people belong. Each one is the same simple pattern, in a different shape.
